title: Cassini app private data in a Library v2 file: manifest x["codemyriad.io"], schema 1
description: S-12 §3 (D44). Everything from a meeting's meeting.json except notes (x["gocassini.com"].notes, D13), plus the session link (sessionId, origin, namePrefix, revision), automaticTitle and the track/span map. The offsets-assumed-zero marker is not here: its only home is x["gocassini.com"].recovery.offsetsAssumedZero (D19, S-12 §11 Q7). Rebuild rule: meeting.json = {id: sessionId, revision: revision, namePrefix: namePrefix, namePrefixSource (only if present): namePrefixSource, notes: x["gocassini.com"].notes or [], ...meeting, ...passthrough}; see MAPPING.md. Relative $refs point at ux-draft/meeting.schema.json so meeting.json and this object can never drift apart.
$comment: Format rules (format.gocassini.com, Private use and Extensibility): this object is ours; readers MUST carry forward members they do not know at every depth and MUST NOT touch other domains' x entries. Writing it changes the manifest, so CASSINI_PAYLOAD_SHA256/RAW_BYTES are recomputed. Export 'without private data' deletes all of x. JSON integers above 2^53-1 inside passthrough or meeting must survive byte-exact (use a lossless JSON number type).

schema.description: Version of this object. A reader that meets a higher value keeps the whole object unchanged and treats the file as having no app data it can edit.

sessionId.description: meeting.json id, verbatim (case kept). Together with origin, the meeting's identity (S-12 §1).

origin.description: The session folder's prefix: .cassini/sessions/<origin>-<sessionId>/. Received iff meeting.received is an object.

namePrefix.description: S-12 §2 prefix, chosen once and never recomputed. Mirrors meeting.json namePrefix (optional v2 member of meeting.schema.json, S-12 §11 Q11).

namePrefixSource.description: Optional; mirrors meeting.json namePrefixSource: present in one copy iff present in the other, never in passthrough. How namePrefix was chosen (names.py, S-12 §11 Q12): recorded = capture start + recorded UTC offset; legacy-device-tz = no valid offset, the Library device's zone at first conversion; date-tag = a received file's DATE; import-time = conversion/import time (received without a usable DATE, or unknown start, Q16). The last two mark an assumption.

revision.description: meeting.json revision. Bumped together with meeting.json by every journaled operation; the higher revision wins in reconciliation (S-12 §3, §7).

meeting.description: meeting.json members that meeting.schema.json v1 defines, other than id, revision, notes, namePrefix, namePrefixSource and published (which live at the x top level or nowhere), each verbatim (unknown members nested inside them stay in place). A schema-1 writer puts exactly these keys here and every other top-level meeting.json member in passthrough. Members absent from meeting.json are absent here (speakerMerges and recordingDetails are optional): absence is preserved, never normalised to [] or {}.

title.description: The stored title, null when the automatic name applies (D38.4). The manifest meeting.title and the TITLE tag hold the displayed title instead.

speakers.description: Verbatim and in order: id, name (null when unnamed), provenance, colourIndex, nameCleared. Ids are the original, unmerged speaker ids the transcript bodies use.

speakerMerges.description: Ordered merge history, verbatim. Undo removes the last entry. Transcript bodies keep the original ids (S-12 §11 Q2).

transcript.description: status, reference and model, verbatim. The source of truth for the words is the file's default words transcript (S-12 §11 Q14).

received.description: Received-file metadata verbatim. sha256 stays the original file's hash (duplicate detection, UX4), not the Library file's.

passthrough.description: Every top-level meeting.json member this schema does not place elsewhere, carried as-is (name and JSON value). Absent when there are none. No key here may also appear in meeting or be id, revision, notes, namePrefix, namePrefixSource or published.

automaticTitle.description: S-12 §11 Q1. The automatic name D38.4 falls back to when meeting.title is null: session.json title for a Recording, the received file's original manifest meeting.title/TITLE for a Received one. Captured at first publish and updated (journaled, revision bump) whenever the automatic name changes. A blank rename restores it, even without a session folder. null when there is none (then the Library falls back to the received name stem or the untitled catalog string).

tracks.description: PROVISIONAL until step 3 (S-12 §4.3, §5): the track/span map into the session folder. Absent for Received. A reader that cannot use a span still has a complete meeting (the mixdown).

kind.description: session.json track kind (microphone, system, browser participant…).

file.description: Path relative to the session folder; confined to it, regular files only.

startOffsetMs.description: Placement on the session timeline; null when unknown (then x["gocassini.com"].recovery.offsetsAssumedZero, D19 / S-12 §11 Q7).

gaps.$comment: D52.2/D52.4: same shape as the browser-protocol session.schema gaps: [{atMs, durationMs, frames, kind}] half-open, session-absolute ms; kinds jump|input|prefix|writer|overflow; null or missing = unknown.
